01About

Currently leading planning and cross-functional operations for God of War: Laufey at Santa Monica Studios — coordinating strategy and release readiness across Production, Design, and Engineering. Previously five seasons on Apex Legends at Respawn, co-founding an 80+ member playtest program.

Most of my title history sits in QA, but the work itself has increasingly been production: planning cadences, cross-functional coordination, and process ownership — and that's the direction I'm building toward. My path started in art and animation, which still shapes how I think about quality and workflow: designed in, not just tested for.
